theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_covering_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (g φ : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) → Integrable φ μ → (∀ (ζ : Ambient n ℓ) (s r : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ r → (∫ x in closedBall ζ s, g x ∂μ) / s ^ n ≤ (∫ x in closedBall ζ r, g x ∂μ) / r ^ n + ∫ τ in Ioc s r, (∫ x in closedBall ζ τ, φ x ∂μ) / τ ^ n) → (∀ᵐ ζ ∂μ, 1 ≤ g ζ → ∃ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t ∧ Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ μ.real (closedBall ζ ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 t)) → ∫ x in {x | 1 ≤ g x}, g x ∂μ ≤ 5 ^ n * omega n ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹) * (∫ x, g x ∂μ) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ x, φ x ∂μ
